svg.title: Triffecta: less fragmentation, more scale
svg.desc: Before and after campaign operations. Brands and Agencies use many platform log-ins, repeat campaign setup per brand and SKU, manage campaigns separately, and consolidate disconnected reporting. Triffecta provides one login to create, replicate and manage existing campaigns; unified data and customised cross-retailer reporting; integrations; and AI and day-parting to match content, media and spend to customer opportunity. Drive outcomes by acting on cross-retailer insights and scaling winning campaigns with less manual work.

text.tspan: Triffecta unifies campaign operations for brands and agencies.
Report across retailers by data, SKU,
AI + day-parting align content, media & spend
Scale winning campaigns with less manual work
Illustrative ecosystem; platform availability depends on supported integrations.
